list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment AS __text,environment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT environment AS __text,environment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context ORDER BY 1

list.name: deployment
list.label: Deployment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT deployment AS __text,deployment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context WHERE environment=${environment:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT deployment AS __text,deployment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context WHERE environment=${environment:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1

list.name: chain
list.label: Source chain
list.query: SELECT role||' · '||chain_id::text AS __text,chain_instance_id::text AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} ORDER BY role
list.definition: SELECT role||' · '||chain_id::text AS __text,chain_instance_id::text AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} ORDER BY role

list.name: rollup

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT rollup_id::text AS __text,rollup_id::text AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND role='l2' ORDER BY 1

list.name: instance
list.label: Native instance
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT s.instance AS __text,s.instance AS __value FROM eez.lifecycle_coverage s WHERE s.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT s.instance AS __text,s.instance AS __value FROM eez.lifecycle_coverage s WHERE s.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Bytes, coverage and provenance
panels.description: Purchased blobs include canonically included reverted posts. Utilization uses authenticated, exact codec-v0 lengths and purchased capacity for the same measured subset: 126,976 usable bytes per blob. Missing/pruned/unsupported/authentication failures remain unknown. Follower derivation and historical recovery capability are separate, not inferred from this collector. Measurement coverage is over ABI-decoded posting receipts; unknown and invalid methods appear in the classification-coverage panel.

options.content: Purchased blobs include canonically included reverted posts. Utilization uses authenticated, exact codec-v0 lengths and purchased capacity for the same measured subset: 126,976 usable bytes per blob. Missing/pruned/unsupported/authentication failures remain unknown. Follower derivation and historical recovery capability are separate, not inferred from this collector. Measurement coverage is over ABI-decoded posting receipts; unknown and invalid methods appear in the classification-coverage panel.

panels.title: Purchased and measured populations
panels.description: Selected canonical type-3 posting receipt population, including failures. See chain coverage before interpreting an empty interval.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS included_type3_posts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT r.success) AS reverted_posts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.measurement_state='measured') AS measured_posts,sum(r.purchased_blobs)::text AS known_purchased_blobs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.accounting_gap IS NOT NULL) AS accounting_gaps FROM eez.posting_blob_measurements r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid HAVING EXISTS(SELECT FROM eez.index_coverage ready JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND c.role='l1' AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND ready.frozen_reason IS NULL AND ready.collection_error IS NULL AND ready.last_success_at BETWEEN now()-interval '90 seconds' AND now()+interval '5 seconds')

panels.title: Weighted purchased-capacity utilization
panels.description: Ratio of totals over exactly the same measured subset; zero denominator or no measurement is NULL. Never divides partial bytes by all purchased blobs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(r.encoded_bytes) FILTER(WHERE r.measurement_state='measured')::text AS measured_bytes,sum(r.purchased_blobs) FILTER(WHERE r.measurement_state='measured')::text AS measured_purchased_blobs,sum(r.encoded_bytes) FILTER(WHERE r.measurement_state='measured')/NULLIF(sum(r.purchased_blobs*r.usable_bytes_per_blob) FILTER(WHERE r.measurement_state='measured'),0) AS purchased_capacity_utilization,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.measurement_state='measured')::numeric/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS measurement_coverage FROM eez.posting_blob_measurements r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid HAVING EXISTS(SELECT FROM eez.index_coverage ready JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND c.role='l1' AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND ready.frozen_reason IS NULL AND ready.collection_error IS NULL AND ready.last_success_at BETWEEN now()-interval '90 seconds' AND now()+interval '5 seconds')

panels.title: Measurement states · canonical posts
panels.description: Separates not measured, pruned, unsupported codec/carrier, authentication failure and exact measured bytes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.measurement_state,r.measurement_provenance,count(*) AS posts FROM eez.posting_blob_measurements r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Execution versus blob fees · exact included spend
panels.description: Exact wei of the source chain; no exchange-rate or fiat assumption. Reverted included blobs still cost money. Sums include known charges only; any incomplete-receipt count means the complete population total is unknown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(r.execution_paid)::text AS known_execution_paid_wei,sum(r.blob_paid)::text AS known_blob_paid_wei,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.accounting_gap IS NOT NULL) AS incomplete_receipts FROM eez.posting_blob_measurements r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid HAVING EXISTS(SELECT FROM eez.index_coverage ready JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND c.role='l1' AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND ready.frozen_reason IS NULL AND ready.collection_error IS NULL AND ready.last_success_at BETWEEN now()-interval '90 seconds' AND now()+interval '5 seconds')

panels.title: Authenticated-byte detail and latest retrieval duration
panels.description: Latest actual retrieval/authentication attempt, not a histogram or a fresh timing on every enrichment poll. A measured included post and successful applied settlement are separate facts. No verified applied-range evidence is not proof that a post was unapplied.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) AS inclusion_time,'0x'||encode(r.transaction_hash,'hex') AS transaction,r.success,r.purchased_blobs::text,r.measurement_state,r.measurement_provenance,r.codec_version,r.encoded_bytes::text,r.retrieval,r.measured_at,r.last_attempt_at,r.retrieval_duration_ns::double precision/1e9 AS latest_retrieval_seconds,r.has_applied_settlement FROM eez.posting_blob_measurements r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid AND (${source_hash:sqlstring}='' OR encode(r.transaction_hash,'hex')=lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x',''))) ORDER BY r.timestamp_seconds DESC,r.transaction_index DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Composer-reported allowance utilization · candidate population
panels.description: Candidate reports from retained native events only. Not authenticated-byte provenance, not canonical paid utilization, and not averaged with the canonical ratio.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp((e.payload->>'observed_at_unix_ms')::numeric/1000.0) AS time,e.payload#>>'{event,attempt,generation}' AS generation,e.payload#>>'{event,encoded_bytes}' AS reported_bytes,e.payload#>>'{event,blob_allowance}' AS reported_allowance,(e.payload#>>'{event,encoded_bytes}')::numeric/NULLIF((e.payload#>>'{event,blob_allowance}')::numeric*126976,0) AS reported_allowance_utilization FROM eez.lifecycle_event_history e WHERE e.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND e.instance IN (${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp((e.payload->>'observed_at_unix_ms')::numeric/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND e.payload#>>'{event,event}'='attempt_prepared' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT c.role,c.chain_id::text,c.rollup_id::text,v.indexed_from::text,v.indexed_through::text,v.incomplete_blocks,v.last_success_at,v.collection_error,v.frozen_reason FROM eez.index_coverage v JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) ORDER BY c.role

panels.title: Posting classification coverage · full indexed interval
panels.description: Decoded posting panels and blob coverage exclude unknown/invalid methods. This lifetime indexed-interval coverage is shown beside them; it is not limited to the dashboard time window. Unknown method rows do not become zero paid costs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.role,v.tracked_contract_receipts,v.decoded_post_receipts,v.invalid_post_calldata_receipts,v.other_method_receipts,v.unknown_method_receipts,v.method_collection_errors,v.last_method_attempt_at,v.source_valid FROM eez.posting_coverage v JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring})

list.name: Native restart observations
list.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(e.started_at_ms/1000.0) AS time,'Native process epoch: '||e.liveness AS text,'restart' AS tags FROM eez.lifecycle_epoch_status e WHERE e.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND e.instance IN (${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(e.started_at_ms/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) ORDER BY time LIMIT 200

list.name: Local policy dispositions
list.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(t.observed_at_ms/1000.0) AS time,'Local disposition: '||t.claimed_outcome AS text,t.source->>'direction' AS tags FROM eez.lifecycle_local_policy_evidence t JOIN eez.lifecycle_coverage s USING(source_id) WHERE t.evidence_state='local_policy' AND s.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND s.instance IN (${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(t.observed_at_ms/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) ORDER BY time LIMIT 200
